explanation: The Almighty Creator who calls His people back to His law and promises to return in judgment.
The process by which the faith of God's servants is purified so they may offer righteous gifts, like silver refined by fire.
The act where the people withhold tithes and offerings that belong to God instead of giving them to the temple.
The portion of income or harvest that, according to the law, is to be given to God's house to support its service.
A metaphorical description of the prophet Elijah who will come before the great day to unite fathers and children.
The coming time when the Lord comes in His glory, often called "the terrible day" or the day of judgment.
Those who break God's commands by marrying foreigners or treating women unjustly through divorce.
